title: Citation Graph
description: Mission section 13: Directed graph of source relationships with evidence-gated edges

source_to.description: Source ID being cited or referenced

evidence.description: Non-empty justification for the edge relationship (required per mission section 13)
examples: source_to's methodology directly supports the argument in section 3.2
source_to explicitly replicates the experimental design from source_from
source_to contradicts the findings presented in section 4.1 of source_from

verified.description: Whether this relationship has been manually verified by human review

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when edge was added

properties.description: source_from cites source_to in its bibliography
properties.semantic: Structural reference; no claim about agreement/disagreement

properties.description: source_from is cited by source_to (inverse of CITES)
Evidence in source_to supports claims in source_from
properties.note: Must not be inferred from citation alone — only from explicit textual claim

properties.description: Evidence in source_to contradicts or refutes claims in source_from
properties.note: Must not be inferred from citation alone — only from explicit textual claim

properties.description: source_to builds upon or extends the work in source_from
properties.note: e.g., source_to uses source_from's method in a new domain

properties.description: source_to reproduces or replicates the experiment/analysis in source_from
properties.note: Success or failure of replication should be noted in evidence

properties.description: source_to identifies and corrects an error in source_from
properties.note: Links to retraction/correction events in academic_source_events
Both source_from and source_to should have retraction_status=RETRACTED

evidence_requirement.description: Every edge requires a non-empty evidence string (mission section 13)

semantic_inference.description: SUPPORTS/CONTRADICTS must be derived from explicit textual claims, never inferred from citation existence alone

no_silent_edges.description: Edges are never deleted or silently modified; corrections create new edges with CORRECTS type

uniqueness.description: At most one edge with (source_from, source_to, edge_type) to avoid duplicates
